Yax Nuun Ahiin (also called "Curl Snout") came to the throne in 378 and ruled for 42 years. His name appears on a stela at Tikal and also at Kaminaljuyu, a site near modern Guatemala City. He probably died about 420. Yax Nuun Ahiin I had no successor named on the monuments of Tikal until much later.
